proposals.title: Calm orbits
proposals.direction: r004-03 refined: the anti-banding texture layer is removed, and a lit node now only warms the backdrop softly (slower in and out, smaller and fainter, no sphere flare, motes barely move). Amber and teal lights, frosted-glass UI.

proposals.title: Calm orbits, room palette only
proposals.direction: r005-01 with the backdrop strictly in the room's own neutral tokens: lights in --ink, --ink-mute, --node-open and --line; motes in ink and ink-mute. No accent (amber) and no extra colour (teal). The UI keeps the app's accent.

proposals.title: Calm orbits, amber only
proposals.direction: r005-01 without the extra colour: the teal lights become the room's own --path-muted and --line, so the backdrop is amber light on navy only. Motes in cream and ink-mute.
